title: 活性污泥曝氣槽設計~Activated-sludge aeration-basin design
focus: 以質量、氧量及固體年齡建立曝氣槽~Aeration-basin reasoning from mass, oxygen and solids age
summary: 在虛擬實驗室設計活性污泥水線，依序確定進料、容積、生物量、排泥、需氧與沉澱介面。使用簡化模型比較方案，所有數字均非任何實廠設定。~Design an activated-sludge liquid line in a virtual laboratory: establish feed, volume, biomass, wasting, oxygen and clarification interfaces. Compare options with simplified models; no number is an actual plant setting.

units.title: 設計日進料邊界：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Design-day influent boundary: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「設計日進料邊界」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at design-day influent boundary.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「設計日進料邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for design-day influent boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「設計日進料邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the design-day influent boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 曝氣槽有效容積：水力停留時間~Aeration-basin active volume: Hydraulic retention time
units.mechanism: 名目停留時間 V/Q 是容積周轉時間；短流與死區會使實際停留時間分布偏離此平均值。本單元在「曝氣槽有效容積」觀察此因果關係。~Nominal retention V/Q is a volume turnover time; short-circuiting and dead zones distort the actual residence-time distribution. Examine this relationship at aeration-basin active volume.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有效容積 V=800 m³、流量 Q=2400 m³/d。公式 t=24V/Q；代入 24*800/2400 = 8 h。適用邊界：有效容積不含不可用空間；不代表所有水團均停留同樣久。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: effective volume V=800 m³ and flow Q=2400 m³/d. Formula t=24V/Q; substitution 24*800/2400 = 8 h. Boundary: Effective volume excludes unusable space; not every parcel remains for the same duration.
units.verify: 用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「曝氣槽有效容積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for aeration-basin active volume; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: V/Q 就是每一滴水的精確停留時間。~V/Q is the exact residence time of every drop.
units.practice: 先點選「曝氣槽有效容積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the aeration-basin active volume measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 有機負荷與微生物庫存：食微比與生物量庫存~Organic food/biomass inventory: Food-to-microorganism ratio and inventory
units.mechanism: 食微比比較每天有機負荷與池內生物固體庫存；BOD、COD、MLSS與MLVSS的基準不得混用。本單元在「有機負荷與微生物庫存」觀察此因果關係。~F/M compares daily organic load with biomass inventory; BOD, COD, MLSS and MLVSS bases must not be mixed. Examine this relationship at organic food/biomass inventory.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=2000 m³/d、BOD=0.20 kg/m³、V=1000 m³、MLVSS=2 kg/m³。公式 F/M=QS/(VX)；代入 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。適用邊界：完全混合名目比值，未包含不可生物分解分率與溫度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=2000 m³/d, BOD=0.20 kg/m³, V=1000 m³ and MLVSS=2 kg/m³. Formula F/M=QS/(VX); substitution 2000*0.20/(1000*2) = 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Boundary: Nominal completely mixed ratio; nonbiodegradable fractions and temperature are excluded.
units.verify: 分別量測流量、可生化基質與揮發性固體，再追蹤出水趨勢。在離線場景為「有機負荷與微生物庫存」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure flow, biodegradable substrate and volatile solids separately and track effluent trends. Build an offline evidence table for organic food/biomass inventory; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把惰性固體當活性生物量，會低估真正食微比。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Counting inert solids as active biomass understates the true F/M. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: MLSS與活性微生物量完全等同。~MLSS is exactly equal to active microbial mass.
units.practice: 先點選「有機負荷與微生物庫存」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把MLVSS降成1.5 kg/m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)。與基準 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the organic food/biomass inventory measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only MLVSS to1.5 kg/m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.2666667 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d). Compare with baseline 0.2 kg BOD/(kg MLVSS·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 排泥與固體年齡：污泥齡與固體流失~Wasting and solids age: Sludge age and solids losses
units.mechanism: 污泥齡等於系統固體庫存除以每天排出的固體；出水帶泥也必須列入，不只剩餘污泥。本單元在「排泥與固體年齡」觀察此因果關係。~SRT equals system solids inventory divided by daily solids losses; effluent carryover counts as well as wasting. Examine this relationship at wasting and solids age.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：庫存6000 kg、剩餘污泥400 kg/d、出水固體100 kg/d。公式 SRT=M/(W+E)；代入 6000/(400+100) = 12 d。適用邊界：準穩態且計算邊界一致；忽略日內庫存變化。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: inventory6000 kg, wasted solids400 kg/d and effluent solids100 kg/d. Formula SRT=M/(W+E); substitution 6000/(400+100) = 12 d. Boundary: Quasi-steady inventory with consistent boundaries; intraday inventory changes are neglected.
units.verify: 以排泥流量乘固體濃度，並同步估出水SS負荷。在離線場景為「排泥與固體年齡」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Multiply wasting flow by solids concentration and estimate concurrent effluent SS load. Build an offline evidence table for wasting and solids age; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 二沉池帶泥會降低污泥齡，不能只調排泥閥猜測。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clarifier carryover lowers SRT and cannot be diagnosed by wasting settings alone. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 不排剩餘污泥就代表沒有生物固體損失。~No intentional wasting means no biomass loss.
units.practice: 先點選「排泥與固體年齡」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水固體提高至200 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10 d。與基準 12 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the wasting and solids age measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only effluent solids to200 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10 d. Compare with baseline 12 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 鼓風需氧與現場效率：氧轉移與曝氣功率~Oxygen and field-transfer efficiency: Oxygen transfer and aeration power
units.mechanism: 氧需求與設備供氧能力須用相同工況基準；清水標準效率不能直接當污水池中的效率。本單元在「鼓風需氧與現場效率」觀察此因果關係。~Oxygen demand and equipment transfer capacity require the same conditions; clean-water standard efficiency is not wastewater performance. Examine this relationship at oxygen and field-transfer efficiency.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想需氧量480 kg O₂/d、現場修正供氧效率1.5 kg O₂/kWh。公式 Pavg=O2/(24 Efield)；代入 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW。適用邊界：平均功率示範，未含尖峰、混合需求或備援餘度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical oxygen demand480 kg O₂/d and field-corrected efficiency1.5 kg O₂/kWh. Formula Pavg=O2/(24 Efield); substitution 480/(24*1.5) = 13.33333 kW. Boundary: Average-power illustration; peaks, mixing requirements and reserve margin are excluded.
units.verify: 把溶氧、尾氣與電表同步；用一段變負載試驗比較回應。在離線場景為「鼓風需氧與現場效率」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize DO, off-gas and power data and compare responses during a changing-load trial. Build an offline evidence table for oxygen and field-transfer efficiency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 散氣器堵塞會提高壓力而降低氧轉移，風量增加未必有效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged diffusers can raise pressure while reducing transfer, so more airflow may be ineffective. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 把風量加倍必定使有效供氧加倍。~Doubling airflow necessarily doubles useful oxygen transfer.
units.practice: 先點選「鼓風需氧與現場效率」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把供氧效率降成1.2 kg O₂/kWh，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 kW。與基準 13.33333 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the oxygen and field-transfer efficiency measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only transfer efficiency to1.2 kg O₂/kWh with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 kW. Compare with baseline 13.33333 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 硝化額外需氧：硝化的氧需求收支~Additional nitrification oxygen: Oxygen balance for nitrification
units.mechanism: 氨氮氧化成硝酸鹽消耗氧；以氮質量為基準的化學計量與有機碳需氧量應分別列出。本單元在「硝化額外需氧」觀察此因果關係。~Oxidizing ammonia nitrogen to nitrate consumes oxygen; nitrogen-based stoichiometry and carbonaceous oxygen demand must be listed separately. Examine this relationship at additional nitrification oxygen.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：假想轉化氨氮量N=30 kg N/d、理論係數4.57 kg O₂/kg N。公式 O2=4.57N；代入 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d。適用邊界：理論完全氧化上界計量，未扣細胞合成或考慮動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: hypothetical ammonia conversionN=30 kg N/d and theoretical factor4.57 kg O₂/kg N. Formula O2=4.57N; substitution 4.57*30 = 137.1 kg O₂/d. Boundary: Theoretical complete-oxidation stoichiometry; biomass assimilation and kinetics are omitted.
units.verify: 用氨、亞硝酸與硝酸三者的氮收支核對，不只看溶氧。在離線場景為「硝化額外需氧」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Check a nitrogen balance using ammonia, nitrite and nitrate rather than DO alone. Build an offline evidence table for additional nitrification oxygen; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 低溫或抑制物可使氨突破，即使供氧功率正常。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Cold conditions or inhibitors can cause ammonia breakthrough despite normal aeration power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 有足夠氧就能保證任意溫度下完全硝化。~Enough oxygen guarantees complete nitrification at any temperature.
units.practice: 先點選「硝化額外需氧」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氨氮量改成40 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 182.8 kg O₂/d。與基準 137.1 kg O₂/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the additional nitrification oxygen measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only ammonia load to40 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 182.8 kg O₂/d. Compare with baseline 137.1 kg O₂/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 前置無氧區碳源：反硝化的電子供體需求~Pre-anoxic carbon source: Electron-donor demand for denitrification
units.mechanism: 硝酸鹽還原需要電子供體；理論COD當量僅是起點，可利用碳、細胞產率與溶氧競爭會改變需求。本單元在「前置無氧區碳源」觀察此因果關係。~Nitrate reduction needs an electron donor; theoretical COD equivalence is only a starting point because available carbon, growth and oxygen competition alter demand. Examine this relationship at pre-anoxic carbon source.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：待還原硝酸氮20 kg N/d、理論COD當量2.86 kg/kg N。公式 CODmin=2.86N；代入 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d。適用邊界：理論電子當量示範，不能當現場加藥劑量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: nitrate nitrogen20 kg N/d and theoretical COD equivalence2.86 kg/kg N. Formula CODmin=2.86N; substitution 2.86*20 = 57.2 kg COD/d. Boundary: Theoretical electron-equivalent illustration; not a field chemical dose.
units.verify: 同時看硝酸鹽、可利用COD與溶氧，檢查回流帶氧。在離線場景為「前置無氧區碳源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Observe nitrate, available COD and DO together and inspect oxygen introduced by recirculation. Build an offline evidence table for pre-anoxic carbon source; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 回流氧先消耗基質，會讓只按硝酸鹽估碳量的模型偏低。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Returned oxygen consumes substrate and makes a nitrate-only carbon estimate too low. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總COD全都可以立即供反硝化使用。~All total COD is immediately available for denitrification.
units.practice: 先點選「前置無氧區碳源」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把硝酸氮改成25 kg N/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 71.5 kg COD/d。與基準 57.2 kg COD/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the pre-anoxic carbon source measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only nitrate nitrogen to25 kg N/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 71.5 kg COD/d. Compare with baseline 57.2 kg COD/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 內回流與水力負荷：內回流與水力負荷~Internal recycle and hydraulics: Internal recirculation and hydraulic load
units.mechanism: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「內回流與水力負荷」觀察此因果關係。~Recirculation returns reactants upstream while increasing pipe and zone throughput; recycle ratio is not removal efficiency. Examine this relationship at internal recycle and hydraulics.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水Q=1000 m³/d、內回流Qr=2000 m³/d。公式 Qzone=Q+Qr；代入 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d。適用邊界：只計指定區域的循環水力負荷；外部排放仍須另作平衡。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influentQ=1000 m³/d and internal recycleQr=2000 m³/d. Formula Qzone=Q+Qr; substitution 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d. Boundary: Hydraulic throughput of one specified zone only; external discharge has a separate balance.
units.verify: 在流路圖分開標示內回流與真正出水，避免重複計量。在離線場景為「內回流與水力負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Mark internal recycle separately from final effluent to avoid double counting. Build an offline evidence table for internal recycle and hydraulics; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 內回流量越大等於淨產水越多。~Greater internal recycle means more net water production.
units.practice: 先點選「內回流與水力負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qr改成3000 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4000 m³/d。與基準 3000 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the internal recycle and hydraulics measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qr to3000 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4000 m³/d. Compare with baseline 3000 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 二沉池固液分離：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Secondary clarification: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「二沉池固液分離」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at secondary clarification.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「二沉池固液分離」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for secondary clarification; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「二沉池固液分離」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the secondary clarification measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: DO、流量與實驗室交叉核對：感測器偏移校正~DO/flow/laboratory cross-check: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「DO、流量與實驗室交叉核對」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at DO/flow/laboratory cross-check.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「DO、流量與實驗室交叉核對」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for DO/flow/laboratory cross-check; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「DO、流量與實驗室交叉核對」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the DO/flow/laboratory cross-check measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
